label: DeepSeek V4 Pro
notes: Cluster-tier model: the smallest published quant is ~791 GiB, so it needs a sizable cluster. 671B/37B-active, 61 layers, arch deepseek4 — a different model from Flash, read by the pinned llama.cpp.
Every number above is measured metadata: byte counts, sha256 digests and the revision come from the HF API and from HTTP Range reads of the GGUF headers (unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813-GGUF).

Geometry is read from the model's own config.json and GGUF header: 671B total / 37B active, 61 decode layers, n_embd 7168, MLA KV. This is a DIFFERENT model from DeepSeek-V4-Flash (304B, 43 layers), not another precision of it.

The notes that used to sit here were copied wholesale from deepseek-v4-flash.json and described that model instead -- its 43 blocks, its compress_ratios, and a DSpark draft module that belongs to Flash and targets layers 40/41/42 of a 43-layer stack. The `speculative` block carrying those same Flash values was removed for the same reason: it was never measured against this model, and it has no consumer outside the frozen ds4 tree. `release` said 0731 (Flash's date); the Pro build is 0813, as the GGUF filenames say.
